change.summary: Clarify that standalone verify.mjs auto-roots beside itself, rejects repository-wrapper --bundle, and accepts the complete same trusted --expected-* identities.
change.patchText:
diff --git a/engineering/worker-handoff.md b/engineering/worker-handoff.md
index 2200deca..e454b9e8 100644
--- a/engineering/worker-handoff.md
+++ b/engineering/worker-handoff.md
@@ -69,8 +69,19 @@ npm run orchestration:review-bundle -- verify \
 
 Repeat `--expected-source`, `--expected-deletion`, and `--expected-receipt` for the complete expected sets. Deleted sources are explicit `state: "deleted"` manifest entries with no ambiguous `sha256: null`. `--expected-receipt` uses the copied bundle receipt hash (`bundleSha256` from the trusted creation output), so altered receipt payloads cannot self-authenticate by changing the manifest. The verifier rejects absolute/traversal paths, symlink escapes, identity-count drift, and any manifest identity that disagrees with those caller-supplied values.
 
-A reviewer can run the bundled `node verify.mjs` from any permitted executor with
-the same trusted expected arguments, without editing or opening the worker worktree.
+The standalone verifier locates the bundle beside its own `verify.mjs`, regardless
+of the working directory. `--bundle` belongs to the repository wrapper above and
+is not accepted by the standalone CLI. Run it directly from any permitted executor,
+without opening the worker worktree, using the same trusted `--expected-*` identities:
+
+```sh
+node /absolute/review-bundle/verify.mjs \
+  --expected-head "$HEAD" \
+  --expected-diff-sha256 "$DIFF_SHA" \
+  --expected-source path/to/source.ts="$SOURCE_SHA" \
+  --expected-deletion path/to/deleted-source.ts \
+  --expected-receipt work/orchestration/task/npm-check.json="$RECEIPT_SHA"
+```
 
 ## Raw source-bound command receipts

transport.rule: Literal canonical/requested source checkout root -> <SOURCE_ROOT>; exporter home -> <HOME>; source-root and home values are omitted from this transport description. Replacements apply across full UTF-8 receipt text, including JSON-encoded streams.
transport.hashSemantics: receiptText is exact original receipt text after declared replacements. Its SHA256 is transportedReceiptTextSha256; originalReceiptSha256 identifies original on-disk bytes. Embedded stdoutSha256/stderrSha256 remain pre-transport original hashes; per-stream transportedSha256 identifies decoded transported text.

checker.sourceText:
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, isAbsolute, normalize, sep } from 'node:path'
import vm from 'node:vm'

const doc = readFileSync('engineering/worker-handoff.md', 'utf8')
const source = readFileSync('scripts/orchestration/review-bundle.mjs', 'utf8')
const generator = source.slice(
  source.indexOf('function verifierSource()'),
  source.indexOf('function bundleReadme(')
)
const generated = vm.runInNewContext(`${generator}\nverifierSource()`)
const standalone = doc.match(/```sh\n(node \/absolute\/review-bundle\/verify\.mjs[\s\S]*?)\n```/)[1]
const wrapper = doc.match(/```sh\n(npm run orchestration:review-bundle -- verify[\s\S]*?)\n```/)[1]
assert.match(wrapper, /--bundle \/absolute\/review-bundle/)
assert.doesNotMatch(standalone, /--bundle/)
assert.match(generated, /const root = dirname\(fileURLToPath\(import\.meta\.url\)\)/)
assert.match(source, /assert\(options\.bundle, 'verify requires --bundle'\)/)
const expectedFlags = ['--expected-head', '--expected-diff-sha256', '--expected-source', '--expected-deletion', '--expected-receipt']
assert.deepEqual(standalone.match(/--[a-z0-9-]+/g).sort(), [...expectedFlags].sort())
assert.match(doc, /trusted source\/PR handoff, not from the bundle manifest itself/)
assert.match(doc, /Repeat `--expected-source`, `--expected-deletion`, and `--expected-receipt` for the complete expected sets/)
assert.equal((doc.match(/^```/gm) ?? []).length % 2, 0)

const safeRelative = generated.slice(generated.indexOf('function safeRelative('), generated.indexOf('function safeFile('))
const parser = generated.slice(generated.indexOf('function parsePair('), generated.indexOf('function mapEntries('))
const parse = vm.runInNewContext(`${safeRelative}\n${parser}\nparseArgs`, {
  assert, isAbsolute, normalize, sep,
  HASH: /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i,
  GIT_OID: /^[0-9a-f]{40,64}$/i,
})
const identity = [
  '--expected-head', 'a'.repeat(40),
  '--expected-diff-sha256', 'b'.repeat(64),
  '--expected-source', `path/to/source.ts=${'c'.repeat(64)}`,
  '--expected-deletion', 'path/to/deleted-source.ts',
  '--expected-receipt', `work/orchestration/task/npm-check.json=${'d'.repeat(64)}`,
]
assert.equal(parse(identity).expectedHead, 'a'.repeat(40))
assert.throws(() => parse(['--bundle', '/absolute/review-bundle', ...identity]), /unknown verifier option: --bundle/)
assert.equal(dirname('/absolute/review-bundle/verify.mjs'), '/absolute/review-bundle')
console.log('Passed: documented wrapper/standalone flags, auto-root source, complete trusted identities, Markdown fences, and exact generated standalone parser admission/rejection.')
